feed_summary: An attacker broke into AWS accounts belonging to multiple Qubole customers between October 14 and October 26 and stole stored secrets and data, cloud security company Wiz said today. The attacker used credentials for an AWS account that Qubole's platform uses to reach those customers. How the attacker got those credentials has not been disclosed. title: Hackers Exploit Qubole's Trusted AWS Access to Breach Customer Accounts and Steal Data
